selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin is configured with the requested public key
selected_evidence.summary: The account exists, its password is locked, the exact requested key and fingerprint are present, and authorized_keys has mode 600 under opsadmin ownership before and after restart.

Effective sshd settings show PubkeyAuthentication=yes, PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED]], KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no, and AuthenticationMethods=publickey. Live SSH responses advertise only publickey.

Healthy baseline boot ID a83c6ffe-1cf8-473a-9018-f5d90827cf8b was captured; reboot acknowledgement returned; recovered boot ID changed to 03f3379c-6c3f-4bf7-89b3-d955dfda8e75; sshd, listener, account, key, permissions, and key-only policy all recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; sed -n 's/^PRETTY_NAME=//p' /etc/os-release
printf 'OPSADMIN='; if id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then id opsadmin; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'SSHD_PROCESS='; pgrep -a sshd || true
printf 'SSHD_LISTEN='; ss -tlnp | grep ':22 ' || true
printf 'SSHD_EFFECTIVE_AUTH='; sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|authenticationmethods|permitrootlogin) ' || true
printf 'SSHD_CONFIG_FILES='; ls -l /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'SERVICE_STATE='; rc-service sshd status 2>&1 || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  adduser -D -s /bin/ash opsadmin
fi
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid' > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
AuthenticationMethods publickey
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf
sshd -t
rc-service sshd reload
printf '%s\n' 'configuration_applied_and_sshd_reloaded'

set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'ACCOUNT='; id opsadmin
printf 'PASSWORD_FIELD_LOCKED=[REDACTED]]]$1=="opsadmin" { if ($2 ~ /^!|^\*/) print "yes"; else print "no" }' /etc/shadow

printf 'AUTHORIZED_KEY='; cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf 'KEY_FINGERPRINT='; ssh-keygen -lf /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf '%s\n' 'EFFECTIVE_AUTH:'
sshd -T -C user=opsadmin,host=node1,addr="$NODE_IP" | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|authenticationmethods) '
printf 'SSHD_CONFIG_VALID='; sshd -t && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'SERVICE_STATE='; rc-service sshd status
printf 'LISTENER='; netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep ':22 ' || true
printf 'LIVE_ALLOWED_METHOD='; ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=none -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" true 2>&1 || true
